credits_text: BFI NETWORK PRESENTS AN ELEVATOR PRODUCTIONS FILM KATE DICKIE YAZMIN KAYANI LEWIS PRATT
other_text: A NETTLE PRODUCTION IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE BFI AND THE NATIONAL LOTTERY FUNDED BY THE BFI, WITH THE SUPPORT OF THE SCOTTISH FILMS FUND, THE ROYAL SOCIETY OF EDINBURGH, AND THE SCOTTISH GOVERNMENT CREATIVE INDUSTRIES FUND. description: The poster features a large yellow mask with leafy plants and eyes, with the title 'NETTLE DAY' prominently displayed above.
